resources.string: Back up and restore your SMS
SMS Toolbox needs to keep running in the background to back up your messages as they arrive. Disable battery optimization for this app so Android does not stop it.
SMS Toolbox needs SMS permissions to read your text messages and back them up to your Gmail. MMS and RCS messages are out of scope and will not be backed up.
SMS Toolbox can\'t back up your messages without SMS permission. Grant the permission to continue.
SMS Toolbox can show a notification while messages are backed up or restored, so you can follow the progress.
Background running is not enabled. Messages might not be backed up as they arrive.
